title: On Ensuring that the gate stayed shut
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：ensure　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ensure 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the builder ① ensured that the gate stayed shut year after year, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② ensures that the gate stayed shut for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ensure that the gate stayed shut at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ensured that the gate stayed shut before — a line in the plan for October 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Ensuring that the gate stayed shut year after year, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ ensure a place for every child for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Ensure a place for every child at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ ensures a place for every child year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ensured that the gate stayed shut again when nobody else would.

⑩ To ensure that the gate stayed shut, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody ensures that the gate stayed shut for the whole place again and somebody must ensure that the gate stayed shut year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 保证（一般过去式 ensured that the gate stayed shut：1958 年施工员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 保证（一般现在 ensures that the gate stayed shut：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 保证（不定式 to ensure that the gate stayed shut：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 保证（过去完成时 had ensured that the gate stayed shut：1952 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 保证（动名词 ensuring that the gate stayed shut 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 确保（ensure a place for every child：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去确保确保每个孩子都有位子）
G. v. 确保（ensure a place for every child：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 保证（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 ensures a place for every child，而母亲又一次 ensured that the gate stayed shut）

answers.why: ensure 意为“保证”，1958 年施工员年年地保证保证那道门始终关着，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ensured。
ensure 意为“保证”，自那以后施工员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 ensures。
ensure 意为“保证”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯保证保证那道门始终关着”，此处为不定式 to ensure that the gate stayed shut。
ensure 意为“保证”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人保证过，故用过去完成时 had ensured。
ensure 意为“保证”，施工员说“保证保证那道门始终关着这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 ensuring that the gate stayed shut 作主语。
ensure 意为“确保”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去确保确保每个孩子都有位子”，should ever 之后用原形 ensure a place for every child。
ensure 意为“确保”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻确保确保每个孩子都有位子（ensure a place for every child at once），以后再也不要提起。
ensure 意为“保证”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例确保确保每个孩子都有位子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 ensures。
ensure 意为“保证”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地保证保证那道门始终关着，用一般过去式 ensured 叙述。
ensure 意为“保证”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要保证保证那道门始终关着，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ensure 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the builder ensured that the gate stayed shut year after year, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder ensures that the gate stayed shut for the whole place whenever the site asks.
Ensuring that the gate stayed shut year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever ensure a place for every child for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site ensures a place for every child year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ensured that the gate stayed shut again, and the site remembered that half.
